facades.name: south arcade (KNSM-laan west end)
facades.note: w02-185 2019 view of BAG edges 45-47 (41.9 m), counted per storey band. Ground: 8 glazed runs between the arcade columns (one narrow run at 23.3-25.1 m). First floor: 6 windows, 7 ribbon windows at the storey head (the narrow bay has its own) and the tall steel window of the east bay = 14. Second floor: a tree hides two windows at the east end.

facades.name: SW chamfer
facades.note: w04-216 (2025): three bays of steel ribbon windows in three rows plus the loggia bay at the KNSM-laan end (ground ribbon, recessed glazing on the two upper bands), two second-floor windows per bay.

facades.name: north quay east end
facades.note: w06-6: BAG edge 30, four 3.9 m quay bays (glazing and a pair of doors) under the canopy band; the terrace storeys are out of frame.

facades.name: west head
facades.note: w08-275: three bays of steel windows on two upper rows; the ground row is hidden behind the annex wall and the tree; top band: the serre glazing and the tower bay's window.
